deleteConfirm.title: Delete this channel binding?
deleteConfirm.description: This only removes the channel binding within this system; it does not affect the underlying connection or revoke authorization on the platform side.

webhook.urlLabel: Webhook callback URL (enter it in the Shopify admin under "Notifications → Webhooks"; choose event version 2025-01)
webhook.hint: Paste the URL above when manually adding a webhook in the Shopify admin; the platform verifies the X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 signature with this binding's connection client secret, and any failed verification is rejected.
webhook.subsTitle: Topic → graph subscriptions (each topic can trigger multiple graphs, up to 10 entries)

error.copy: Copy failed; please select and copy manually

remoteWebhooks.title: Shopify shop-side registration (register callbacks in one click via the Admin API)
remoteWebhooks.hint: First subscribe topics → graphs locally above, then register the corresponding topics with Shopify; local subscriptions and shop-side registration are triggered separately and do not sync automatically. The registered URL must be HTTPS; please configure ATLAS_PUBLIC_URL.
remoteWebhooks.loadError: Failed to load shop-side registration status

error.CHANNEL_UNAUTHORIZED: The shop access token has expired; please re-authorize in Connections
